turns.customer: My order #1054 never arrived and the tracking hasn't moved in weeks. What's going on?
turns.reply: I’m sorry your Loft Down Jacket order #1054 was not delivered. Our system shows the order is marked as lost, and we have submitted a $199.00 refund request for approval; a team member will review it, typically within one business day. In the meantime we have issued a one‑time 10% off coupon (code SORRY-4-20260915) that you can use on a future purchase before 2026-12-14. Thanks for your patience.
